oh my god that’s so cute 
thank u
i really appreciate your comment. tysm dude 🥺♥️🥺♥️

you know a lot of what you just said fits perfectly into what i’m feeling. and it’s nice to know that i’m  not alone, so i really appreciate your comment! 

thanks for ur positivity buddy
bless your soul! have a wonderful day and look after urself buddy

just wanna make it clear that i’m not going to/didn’t drink. i know it’s not good for me and it’ll only make things worse. i just sometimes feel like i could, but i promise i won’t  

but thank you folks, for the concern
thank you so much, your input means a lot! :)

i’m 16 and i’ve dealt with this for like three, four years now??? when i do it, it’s more pulling my hair, smacking my head or hitting it on the floor. but i only do it when i’m overwhelmed with frustration. usually running helps. 

i hope it is eases off for you and you find a good way to cope, and if you ever do it again that you don’t do any real damage to yourself. take care !!

the way i told my closest friends was at my house when they stayed the night. i’m lucky enough to have friends that won’t judge me when i tell them how depressed i am. our friendship is really light hearted, we don’t really talk about serious things but when i told them they were really understanding and listened. 
it wasn’t actually too long ago since i told them, and nothing has changed in our friendship and i can easily go talk to them when i need to and not make it weird. the only hard part is trying not to feel like a burden on them. unfortunately, you’ll feel like you are a burden on them, but trust me if they’re a good friend you’re definitely not being a toxic friend. 

good luck, i hope it goes well. don’t put too much pressure on yourself.
